headline: Spread at 85 Points and Record Yields: How to Invest
summary: The spread between Italian BTP and German bond yields rose to 85 basis points as BTP yields climbed further. The article describes yields at record levels.
why: The BTP-Bund spread measures the extra yield investors demand to hold Italian government debt over German Bunds. It is a key gauge of euro-area sovereign risk.
